en.title: No snapshots but reports that run live
en.shortdesc: The report skeleton, scope resolution in Go, and why the browser queries the semantic layer directly with Arrow IPC over HTTP/2.
en.longdesc: Part 4 of a series on building a semantic-layer report engine: the live query runtime resolving scope into per-block query specs, fanning out from the browser over HTTP/2, and shipping columnar Arrow to React.
en.seoTitle: Semantic layer: no snapshots but reports that run live
en.seoDescription: Running reports as live queries: the skeleton, Go scope resolution and Arrow IPC over HTTP/2. Part 4 of a series on semantic-layer report engines.
